description: Get a concise GEO readiness summary for a domain: overall score, grade, top 3 strengths, and top 3 issues to fix. Use this for a quick overview; use analyze_domain for full details including the Trust Signal Evidence payload (raw nav/footer links for LLM-driven semantic classification on non-English sites). Before analysing, decide what kind of page this is (look at it or call extract_page_content, which returns the detected type and the text) and pass page_type; without it, checks that depend on the page type are shown but not scored. Here the page is the site's homepage: pass "homepage" unless the front page is itself another kind of page (a news front or blog index is "index", a one-page local business site is "service", a single-product site is "product").

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. "example.com". Do not include https:// prefix.

page_type.description: What kind of page it is, as you judged it. One of: homepage (The front page of a site or brand: what it offers and where to go next); product (One product for sale, with its price, options and details); category (A shop listing of several products, often with filters and sorting); article (A news story, blog post, guide or essay); index (A news front, blog index or hub page that lists and links to other pages); docs (Technical documentation, a reference page or a dictionary entry); faq (Questions and answers, or a help-centre article about a product or service); service (A business selling a service: trades, practices, restaurants, agencies or software); lodging (A hotel, B&B, campsite or holiday rental with rooms to book); event (One event, concert or show with its date, venue and tickets); recipe (A recipe with ingredients and steps); info (Information from a government body or a nonprofit organisation); contact (Contact details, an about page, terms, privacy or an imprint); forum (A discussion thread, or a question with answers from users). Without it (or with "auto"), checks that depend on the page type are shown but not scored. An unknown value is ignored with a note. It applies to the homepage, the page this summary scores.

render_mode.description: How to fetch the homepage. "static" (default), "auto" (static with Chrome fallback on bot-block), or "chrome" (always render via local headless Chrome).

name: get_geo_summary
